==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in Whisperwood, Sarangrave
* Announcement by '''Berrak of The Phoenix Reach''', [[Crystal Architect of the Spires]]
* The labour cost is increased by the presence of [[Region_qualities#Outlaw_Druj|outlaw Druj]] in the territory

==Date==
* Autumn 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 16 wains of mithril
* 76 crowns and 16 rings in labour costs 
* Three months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Spark_of_Ignition}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, the ''Lighter of the Forge'' will be available to be appointed by the Senators of Urizen
